segments.titleEn: A body stopped in front of the rock
segments.ja: 作戦は、岩のすぐ手前で止まっていました。エレンの巨人は穴を塞ぐためにそこまで来たのに、腕は岩を抱えません。熱い蒸気の中で、大きな体だけが左右に揺れています。意識は落ちたままです。駐屯兵団の精鋭たちは屋根で息を詰め、この兵器が味方なのか敵なのか、もう決められずにいました。トロスト区の残り時間は、巨人の足音で数えていました。
segments.en: The operation had stopped just short of the boulder. Eren's Titan had come that far to plug the hole, and still the arms would not take the rock. In the hot steam the huge body only swayed. His mind was gone. The Garrison elites on the roofs could no longer tell whether this weapon was theirs or the enemy's. What time Trost District had left was being counted in Titan footsteps.

segments.ja: ミカサ・アッカーマンは、その巨人の胸の前から退きません。立体機動装置の刃を握ったまま、彼女はエレンの名前を呼び続けます。周りは止めます。近づきすぎだ、もう人間ではない、と。ミカサにはその区別が使えません。昨日まで隣で走っていた相手を、蒸気の向こうに置いて逃げることができないのです。彼女の選択は作戦を乱します。それでも彼女は、エレンが戻る場所を空にしておきたかった。
segments.en: Mikasa Ackerman would not back away from the Titan's chest. Blades of her ODM gear still in her hands, she kept calling Eren's name. The others told her to stop. She was too close. He was no longer human. That distinction did not work for her. She could not run and leave, beyond the steam, the person who had run beside her yesterday. Her choice tangled the operation. She still wanted somewhere empty for Eren to come back to.

segments.en: The choice landed on Ian, Mitabi, and Rico. The order that reached those elite squad leaders was a cold one. Kill the Titan, or abandon the operation and live. Ian looked deeper into the city. If the hole stayed open, the deaths on this street would not be the end. Mitabi checked his soldiers' faces one by one. Rico ground her teeth and still waited for an order. All three knew that the right answer was not inside them.

segments.ja: アルミン・アルレルトは、恐怖の中で巨人の動きだけを見ていました。殴る腕の向き、止まる位置、ミカサを追いながらも最後の一打ちを外すこと。ただの巨人なら、そんな無駄はしません。アルミンは息を飲んで、一つの仮説を置きます。体は巨人でも、どこかにエレンの意思が残っている。残っているなら、言葉が届く場所もある。彼は屋根を蹴り、誰よりも近くまで降りていきました。
segments.en: Armin Arlert, inside his fear, watched only how the Titan moved. The angle of a swinging arm. The place it stopped. The way it chased Mikasa and still missed the last blow. A Titan with nothing else in it would not waste motion like that. Armin held his breath and set down one hypothesis. The body was a Titan's, and some of Eren's will was still in it. If that was true, there was still a place a voice could reach. He kicked off the roof and dropped closer than anyone.

segments.ja: アルミンは叫びません。近い声で、エレンにだけ分かる話をします。訓練の日々、壁の外にある世界、まだ見ていない土地の話です。英雄になれとは言いません。ここにいてくれ、と繰り返します。人類の兵器である前に、友達の一人でいてくれ、と。蒸気が顔を焼きそうでも、アルミンは下がりません。言葉が届かなければ、次に動くのは精鋭の刃だと分かっていました。
segments.en: Armin did not scream. In a close voice he told Eren things only Eren would know. Days of training. The world outside the walls. Land they had not seen yet. He did not ask him to become a hero. He repeated a smaller request. Stay here. Before you are a weapon for humanity, be one of your friends. Rico counted the elites who remained and set the missing names aside. Far off, Jean was searching the street for a friend's shape. Humanity had plugged one hole. segments.en: After the hole closed, Titans were still inside the city. Unable to leave, they became slower and more dangerous. segments.en: Mikasa kept a cloth on Eren's missing shoulder and did not slow her pace. Armin watched ahead and checked only whether the road was safe. What was needed now was not an explanation. It was to keep the breathing going. Eren's eyelids moved and did not become words. Armin stored that movement as a sign that the mind had not gone out completely.

segments.en: The report to Pyxis began with short numbers. The hole was closed. Two elite leaders were not coming back. The boy with a Titan's power was alive, and his limbs were missing. The commander did not repeat the numbers. From the top of the wall he looked at the new stone in the gate. He offered no praise. What he offered was the next order. Reduce the Titans still inside by dawn. Eren to the medical room. There was no place, after the numbers, to put a story about a hero.

segments.titleEn: An evening when the gaps show
segments.ja: 夕方、ジャンは高い屋根からトロスト区の全体を見ます。閉じた門、まだ動く煙、点になった回収の列。自分の同期が何人残っているか、この高さでも数え切れません。彼は調査兵団の翼を、今日はまだ着ていません。着ていなくても、壁の外の怖さと壁の内の死体が同じ一日にあることを理解しました。エレンが岩を抱えた話は、すでに噂になっています。噂は欠員を埋めません。ジャンは屋根を下り、名前を探す作業に戻ります。
segments.en: In the evening Jean looked over all of Trost District from a high roof. The closed gate. Smoke still moving. The recovery line turned into dots. Even from this height he could not count how many of his classmates were left. He was not yet wearing the Survey Corps wings. Without wearing them, he understood that the fear outside the walls and the corpses inside them belonged to the same day. The story of Eren holding the boulder was already a rumor. A rumor does not fill an empty place. Jean climbed down and went back to searching for names.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉を、声に出して置きます。傷は、体に残るものだけでなく、作戦のあとに残る欠員のことでもあります。岩は、穴を塞いだあの石です。精鋭は、イアンとミタビとリコたちの班です。意識は、巨人の体から離れていたエレンの心です。放棄は、作戦を捨てて逃げる選択でした。彼らはそれを選びませんでした。成功は、門が閉まったことです。戻らない人がいる成功でも、成功です。次にこの通りを思い出すとき、岩の音の低さを思い出してください。
segments.en: Let us leave today's words by saying them. A wound is not only what stays on a body. It is also the empty places an operation leaves behind. The boulder is the stone that plugged the hole. The elites are the squads of Ian, Mitabi, and Rico. Consciousness is the mind that had left Eren's Titan. Abandonment was the choice to drop the operation and run. They did not take it. Success is the gate being closed. It is still success when some people do not come back. The next time you remember this street, remember how low the boulder sounded.

A Titan with nothing else in it would not waste motion like that. Armin held his breath and set down one hypothesis. The body was a Titan's, and some of Eren's will was still in it. If that was true, there was still a place a voice could reach. He kicked off the roof and dropped closer than anyone.

Rico ground her teeth and still waited for an order. All three knew that the right answer was not inside them.
